label: No being is jointly omniscient, omnipotent and wholly good
paraphrase: No being is jointly omniscient, omnipotent and wholly good.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: Supply an actual-world bridge for every case IsGod witness g. On a shared carrier require Omniscient, Omnipotent and WhollyGood of g in the same Rowe signature. On separate carriers warrant that the image represents g itself and require all three predicates of that image. Combined with NoTheisticBeing this would yield the stage-one denial.
connection_plan.blocker: Case GodExists supplies an IsGod witness. HasClassicalAttributes is a separate field, and the case goodness and intellect predicates do not supply Rowe’s conjunction of that bearer by definition. The bearer-preserving interpretation and the suffering and permission premises still need warrant.
